Dependency_Grammar.focus: Binary asymmetrical head-dependent directed relations between words without phrasal nodes
Dependency_Grammar.advantages: Excellent for variable word order, computationally efficient O(n^3) or O(n) transition parsing

Head-driven_Phrase_Structure_Grammar_HPS.focus: Unification of typed feature structures (AVMs), constraint-based generative grammar
Head-driven_Phrase_Structure_Grammar_HPS.advantages: Rigorous lexical head projection, deep semantic interface (Minimal Recursion Semantics)

Lexical_Functional_Grammar_LFG.focus: Dual levels of syntactic representation: c-structure (constituency trees) and f-structure (functional attributes)
Lexical_Functional_Grammar_LFG.advantages: Clear separation of surface word order from grammatical functions (subject, object)

Construction_Grammar_CxG.focus: Non-modular pairing of form and meaning (lexicon and syntax as a continuum)
Construction_Grammar_CxG.advantages: Seamless handling of idioms, semi-productive constructions ('the more, the merrier')
